title: Showcasing my survival game!
author: Pale_Pepper8576
selftext:
Showcasing my survival game! It's essentially like a top-down retro Minecraft with full multiplayer with friends, crafting, building, enemies at night and an endless world. It's all procedurally designed visuals, generated by AI with code. It's pretty fun. Please give feedback!

Next i wanna work on some cool dark caves with some boss enemies, better loot, iron ore, furnaces, diamonds and all that.

https://reddit.com/link/1sicg1l/video/xpnnsfizjiug1/player

comments.author: budas2
comments.body: That's awesome! How long did it take to make? And what did you use for asset generation?

replies.author: Pale_Pepper8576
replies.body:
Thanks!

Just a few hours prompting it with the AI. There's not any really assets at all actually - it's all just made with code right in the game!! No images or models or anything.

replies.author: koalalord9999
replies.body:
If you Havnt already , make sure the game is hardware accelerated before it becomes too big of a refactor to do in one or two goes.

I was making a similar visually styled game, that was trying to set my PC on fire with 92C temps after just 30 minutes of play… and it’s graphics were actually worse LOL

comments.author: Global_Profession_92
comments.body: That’s sick! What engine did you use to build this?

comments.author: guile2912
comments.body:
It is very cool and all, but what's makes it different from other games?

Tell us why would it worth a player 's time?

replies.author: Pale_Pepper8576
replies.body: To be honest I'm just tryna learn making games. It's quite fun to play imo but it's of course similar to Minecraft and the like. But trying to figure out some gameplay twists now

comments.author: Snoo-6077
comments.body: Hey, great game. Is it possible for you to share the process details: what code assistant did you use, what prompts look like, what engine or tech stack did you use.

replies.author: Pale_Pepper8576
replies.body: I'm doing a very iterative prompting process with Tesana. First starting with just the world and taking my time there, making the tiles and all that. Then making it endless, then the character, enemies and so on. Took about 2 days all in

replies.author: Snoo-6077
replies.body: I see, thank you for sharing that!
